key_expressions: Do you happen to have a business card,
If you have a moment, could we talk briefly,
Your team’s project was really impressive,
I think there’s potential for collaboration,
Feel free to contact me anytime,

A: Hello, do you have a moment to talk?
I really enjoyed your presentation earlier.
I have a few questions related to what you shared.
B: Oh, sure! Thanks so much for your interest.
We were worried about the reaction, so that means a lot!
Of course, feel free to ask anything.

A: Do you happen to have a business card? I'd like to stay in touch.
My team is actually working in a similar field.
If possible, I’d love to discuss collaboration sometime.
B: Yes, here you go! My contact info is all there.
Oh really? Sounds like there could be great synergy.
Absolutely — I’d be happy to explore that together.

A: I visited your booth, and your project really stood out.
The integration approach was especially impressive.
Is it possible to speak with someone from your tech team?
B: Thank you! That’s the part we invested the most effort in.
Yeah, people have been responding really well to it.
The tech lead should be nearby — let me check for you!

A: I caught part of your talk, and the explanation was really clear.
Would it be possible to share the materials?
If you email them to me, I’d love to use them in our team meeting.
B: Oh, thank you! We spent quite a while preparing it.
Yes, we have a PDF version ready.
Just give me your email and I’ll send it right away!

A: Do you have a moment now to chat?
Your work seems connected to a project we’re preparing.
If you're open to it, I'd like to walk you through a few details.
B: Yes, now works! I’m curious about your project.
Oh wow, that already sounds interesting.
Great — shall we sit at a table over there?

A: Do you attend other conferences like this often?
I feel like I always learn so much at networking events.
I hope to meet more great people today as well.
B: Yes, I try to come regularly to keep up with industry trends.
Exactly, conversations like these give you new perspectives.
We’re also hoping to connect with many people today!

A: Do you have a public roadmap for your product?
I’m curious about your long-term direction.
If possible, I’d love a quick overview.
B: Some of it is public — there’s a summary on our website.
In general, we’re focusing on sustainable automation solutions.
I can give you a quick explanation — what part are you most curious about?

A: It’s getting a bit noisy here.
That corner looks quieter — should we move?
That way, we can talk in more detail.
B: Yeah, crowds tend to grow around this hour.
Good idea — that spot should be better.
Let’s move and continue talking there.

A: Do you have experience running a service similar to this?
Hearing real stories gives a much clearer picture.
Could you share a bit more about your experience?
B: Yes, we had plenty of trial and error early on.
But once you actually operate it, things start to make sense.
Of course — I’m happy to share anything that might help.

A: I really learned a lot from our conversation today.
I hope we get the chance to collaborate in the future.
Reach out anytime — I’ll schedule a meeting right away.
B: Same here! I got some great insights as well.
Yes, we also see strong potential for collaboration.
I’ll be in touch. Looking forward to working with you!
